QuestInfo.name: How to Enjoy Mushrooms Even More
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p306# in #m10002000# has another favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: #p306# in #m10002000# said he learned of an even better way to cook #t4000013#s and asked me to bring some #b#t4000013#s#k, as well as a #b#t2010005##k.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered the #t4000013#s and #t2010005# to #p306# in #m10002000#. It feels like the dish might actually taste better than the last one, doesn't it?

0.0: Oh, look who it is! The one who helped me out before. I had some pretty good mushroom stew thanks to you. Much appreciated. But now, the fairies in this village are telling me that the stew tastes a whole lot better if you throw in some #t2010005#.
0.1: So, how about it? Could you gather some #b#t4000013#s#k for me, one more time? And if you could pick up a #b#t2010005##k from the general store while you're at it, that'd be great. As you can see, I can't move a single inch from here because I have to guard the entrance to the forest I inherited from my father.

1.0: You're back! The #t4000013#s you brought this time look even tastier than in the last batch. Perfect! Now, if I just add this #t2010005#, I'll be able to whip up something truly amazing.
1.1: Thanks for the help. I think I'm going to have a very special dinner tonight, all thanks to you. As a reward, I'll give you another ore that can be found in our forest. Take care of yourself out there!

item.0: Still no #b#t4000013#s#k and #b#t2010005##k? Man... I just know I could make a legendary dish if I only had those ingredients.

mob.0: Don't forget to hunt the ones I mentioned. I'm waiting here, you know.
